preconditions: All pointer arguments must be valid non-null for their documented roles: haystack and pattern buffer to 0x00587C20, stream object to 0x00587D02, read arguments to 0x0058803F, destination buffer to 0x0058815F, and input string to 0x00589901.
0x0058815F requires a va_list-compatible variadic argument sequence following the fixed argument a2, consumed by sub_58D04D.
0x00589901 locale path assumes dword_8D3F38, when non-null, is a valid locale handle usable by the code-page conversion sub_591FA1.
postconditions: 0x00587C03 returns the result of NhMalloc(a1, 1): a heap block of at least a1 bytes, or NULL on failure.

0x00587C20 returns a pointer to the start of a two-byte pattern match inside the null-terminated haystack a1, returns a1 unchanged when the pattern's first byte is empty, and returns 0 when the haystack is exhausted without a match.
0x00587D02 returns the CRT close result when flag bit 0x40 at stream_object+0x0C is clear; when that bit is set it clears the dword at stream_object+0x0C to 0 and returns -1 without closing.
0x0058803F returns the inner read result sub_58806E(a1, a2, a3, a4) unchanged with the stream lock released.

0x0058815F returns the sub_58D04D formatter result; on the non-overflow path the destination buffer is NUL-terminated at the final cursor position, and on budget underflow the overflow handler sub_58CF35 is invoked instead.
0x00589901 returns the original lpSrcStr pointer in every path; on the ASCII path the string is uppercased in place.
side_effects: 0x00587D02 acquires the stream critical section (StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection) around MSVCCRTFileClose and releases it (AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave), and clears the dword at stream_object+0x0C on the flag-skip path.
0x0058803F acquires StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a4) and releases AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a4) around the inner read.
0x0058815F writes a NUL byte into the destination buffer on the success path.

0x00589901 mutates lpSrcStr in place on the ASCII path; on the locale path it adjusts the dword_8D5A5C reference counter, conditionally enters and leaves critical section 19, allocates a conversion buffer via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc, and passes the converted buffer to sub_58AA6F.
0x00587C03 and 0x00587DB0 are pure delegations with no additional side effects beyond their callees.

disputes.description: Six of the seven functions are labeled __cdecl in raw source; 0x0058815F is unlabeled. The family is recorded as cdecl; the formatter's convention is inferred, not stated in its raw C.

The packet bundles a heterogeneous free-function family (allocator, two-byte string search, locked file close, fixed-arg delegation, locked stream read, variadic formatter, locale uppercase). 'interface' is chosen as the least-wrong kind; it does not assert a shared owner or type across the functions.

Object names (pattern_buffer, stream_object, destination_buffer) are evidence-role labels, not confirmed C++ types. A shared offset pattern or shared this convention does not by itself prove shared ownership.
